records.question: John gets lost on his way home.  His normal trip is 150 miles and would take him 3 hours.  He ends up driving 50 miles out of the way and has to get back on track.  How long did the trip take if he kept the same speed?
records.response:
The original trip was 150 miles at 50 miles per hour.  50 miles out of the way is 50 miles back and 50 miles forward, which is a total of 100 miles.  So his new trip was 150+100 = 250 miles.  If he traveled 250 miles at 50 miles per hour, it took 250 / 50 = 5 hours.
